scope: Use only the 13 current EMASI subjects as the school-subject exploration framework. This does not mean all 13 are required for every major or that they are university admission prerequisites.

relationship_types.label_vi: Mối liên hệ học thuật trực tiếp
relationship_types.criteria: A specific EMASI learning outcome or topic corresponds to a named university programme course, core knowledge area, or explicitly documented prerequisite.

relationship_types.label_vi: Mối liên hệ kiến thức liên quan
relationship_types.criteria: A reliable academic source supports a relevant supporting or interdisciplinary relationship, but the subject is not shown to be a core requirement.

relationship_types.label_vi: Chưa xác định mối liên hệ trực tiếp
relationship_types.criteria: The reviewed evidence does not establish a direct relationship. This is not evidence of student inability or unsuitability.

source_rules: Prefer official university programme pages, curriculum maps, course catalogues, course descriptions, and admission requirements.
Use peer-reviewed research or authoritative academic/professional frameworks for broader disciplinary claims.
A programme listing verifies programme existence only; it does not verify curriculum, prerequisites, skills, careers, or subject relationships.
Record the specific institution and programme. Do not generalize one university's curriculum to every university offering a similarly named major.
Never promote a Pending Verification relationship into the interactive network as a confirmed connection.
Do not infer admission eligibility, aptitude, or suitability from a high-school subject connection.
